findings.title: Critical‑path issue lacking evidence
findings.evidence: audit.browser.verdict contains "NO‑GO... 1 critical‑path issue(s) have no evidence behind them" and grades show 1 unsupported grade out of 29.
findings.fix: Ensure every issue on the critical path has at least one corroborating citation and an associated gate; update the data generation to include evidence for those nodes.
findings.acceptance: Verified when the unsupported grade count drops to zero and the verdict changes to a passing state.

findings.title: Evidence coverage UI shows 0% despite existing data
findings.evidence: The header chip displays "evidence coverage 0%" while tests confirm that generated sub‑issues cite real evidence (tests/data.test.mjs passes "generated sub‑issues cite real evidence").
findings.fix: Calculate coverage based on the ratio of supported/verified issues and update the chip text accordingly.
findings.acceptance: Coverage chip reflects a non‑zero percentage when evidence exists.
